name: thesartorialist-desktop
description: The Sartorialist – Admin-Backend als Mac-App (Tauri v2, WKWebView): Menüleiste, Mitteilungen, Dock-Badge, Schreibtisch-Widget

scripts.build:lokal: TS_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000/admin/ tauri build --bundles app,dmg && node scripts/ablegen.mjs
scripts.build:universal: tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg && node scripts/ablegen.mjs --universal
scripts.icons: node scripts/icons.mjs && tauri icon src-tauri/icons/app-icon-1024.png -o src-tauri/icons && node scripts/icons.mjs
